stories.title: Reconcile full scope and approval boundary
acceptance: Trace DEC-001–041, CAP-01–19 and the 140 captured source stories to planned phases, preserving differences from historical source wording.
Record current health/sample SSE/static preview separately from planned product capabilities; actual holdings and documents remain deferred.

Obtain an explicit full end-to-end requirements and UX decision after all layers have specifications, contracts, local stories and reviewed design options; a phase draft or fixture pass is insufficient.
evidence: Decision-to-phase matrix; open-choice register; owner approval record or explicit unapproved status

stories.title: Select architecture and cost assumptions
acceptance: Compare active A lean AWS training versus B selective SageMaker training without declaring either selected; both retain Lambda and the direct Anthropic client-SDK loop.
Price full launch scope across dev/prod/data/models/evals/builds/storage/notifications and fixed subscriptions within £70 planned plus £30 reserve; record unverified credit as unverified.
Resolve or explicitly escalate old local-PostgreSQL/host assumptions and the historical £50 AWS target through approved ADRs; no cloud changes follow from a draft.
evidence: Option ADR draft; dated price/rights assumptions; full-scope cash stress case with no usable credit

stories.title: Freeze shared versioned contracts and state semantics
acceptance: Define instrument/listing, money/FX, timestamps/known-at, event, ledger, forecast/task/horizon, model, agent, strategy and evaluation contracts with version/error/compatibility rules.
Define contract owners and change review; every record links relevant schema/data/code versions and no-trading authority.
Specify durable-state recovery independently of SSE delivery and preserve additive correction semantics.
evidence: Schema examples; compatibility and migration cases; contract ownership table

stories.title: Approve cross-client product flows
acceptance: Cover discovery-first dashboard, separate holdings/imports, per-horizon forecasts/proof, research/chat, action journal, cost visibility, owner approvals and privacy/recovery flows.

Document loading/empty/error/stale/offline/no-model/disagreement/abstention states and accessibility on web, iPhone, iPad and adaptive Duo layouts. Answered: MP40-Q12b, 5 November 2026 (MP-184): the owner picked "Any window width" (pressed on the page). The option read: "The Apple app lays out by window width, so a narrow iPad window uses the phone layout."

Verify the requested SvelteKit 3 version against current official availability before choosing packages; do not imply it is installed. Agree native/device support and local design/prototype before any authorised Sites sync.
evidence: Local user-flow and state inventory; design options and explicit selection; version/device evidence

stories.title: Define synthetic acceptance coverage and future real-sample intake
acceptance: Index existing local/dev synthetic 30-real-ID packs and PDF/PNG/expected-import/operations companions; mark prices, accounts, transactions and outcomes synthetic.
Identify missing Excel, malformed/blurred/rotated/protected/hostile documents and add to planned coverage; existing clean fixtures do not prove parser robustness or forecast accuracy.
Allow actual screenshots/PDFs to arrive progressively through later private intake; no current planning exit requires them.

stories.title: Cognito identity and owner recovery
acceptance: Specify managed Apple/Google/passkey sign-in and server-verified account linking; email similarity alone cannot merge identities.
Define two independent passkey paths, verified provider links, lost-device/recovery proof, session revocation and sensitive-action reauthentication.
Demonstrate denied cross-environment/cross-owner access and audit recovery/link changes without exposing identity tokens.
evidence: Threat model and auth contracts; recovery/linking negative scenarios; eventual web/native integration results

stories.title: Private durable storage and job contracts
acceptance: Specify isolated dev/prod identities and encrypted storage with least privilege; synthetic dev cannot write production.
Specify conditional ledger/audit/outbox writes and S3 hash/manifest publication boundaries; uploaded bytes and database pointers are not one transaction.
Retries use idempotency keys, bounded backoff and quarantine; no duplicate financial side effect after timeout/replay.
evidence: Access-pattern model; write-failure matrix; planned idempotency/fault-injection cases

stories.title: Launch dashboard cost meter and reconciliation
acceptance: Main dashboard shows dev/prod/local API/shared-unallocated costs with provider/agent/model/feature/service drill-down and source age.
Separate live estimates from delayed billing and gross usage from credit applied/cash; Anthropic billing collection every 6 hours, AWS daily, bounded and cached.
Unknown shared credit stays unknown and is never multiplied per environment; show collector failures and reconciliation discrepancies.
evidence: Cost event and allocation schemas; dashboard states; stale/unknown/adjusted-bill synthetic cases

stories.title: Enforce discretionary spending admission
acceptance: Evaluate forecast monthly cash against £60 warning/£75 reduced optional work/£85 pause-new-optional-paid thresholds while retaining £100 total ceiling and £70+£30 plan.
Use bounded reservations/limits for concurrent jobs; refuse uncovered or unverifiable Claude calls and pause optional calls at agreed low-credit conditions without paid fallback.
Show uncertainty from delayed AWS billing; approval thresholds are not claimed to provide an instantaneous universal AWS shutoff. Keep deterministic essential views available.
evidence: Admission state table; concurrent-reservation and unknown-credit cases; full-workload stress budget

stories.title: Authenticated API and resumable SSE
acceptance: Version authenticated APIs and short-lived heartbeat-enabled SSE; use durable event IDs/cursor recovery where supported, refetch durable records after gaps.
Define reconnect/token-expiry/ordering/dedup/backpressure and multi-tab/background rules; no secrets or durable financial truth solely in a stream.
Cost active connections and validate selected API/Lambda streaming compatibility before implementation; starter unauthenticated volatile SSE is not production evidence.
evidence: API/event examples; disconnect/expired-session cases; streaming compatibility and cost evidence

stories.title: Telemetry, evidence separation and original archive
acceptance: Plan logs 14 days, rich traces 30, run summaries 90 subject to measured cost; maintain distinct durable financial/forecast/approval/source audit lifecycles.
Plan encrypted private S3 originals with renewable 24-month retention and owner extension/deletion controls; define versions/derivatives/backups and no automatic expiry deletion yet.
Redact document contents, holdings, tokens and prompts from operational telemetry; correlation IDs link to access-controlled evidence.
evidence: Record-class retention table; redaction cases; source-to-ledger/model audit examples

stories.title: Instrument identity, entitlement and cadence

Before live activation, resolve owner identities and source rights/history/latency/storage for Yahoo plus exact Twelve Data Grow tier; then propose the balanced research watchlist for owner approval.

Record source capability by listing; 30-minute risk/quote refresh only where supported, otherwise daily labelled analysis and suppressed unsupported intraday alerts; no paid provider addition without approval.

stories.title: Point-in-time ingestion and data health

Backfill toward ten years or inception where entitled; gaps/revisions/partial exposure history remain explicit and cannot be replaced by current constituents.
Handle provider disagreement, missing bars, market holidays/half-days/DST, quota failures and safe daily fallback with provenance.

stories.title: Daily and market-aware refresh orchestration
acceptance: Separate daily formal forecast readiness from supported 30-minute quote/risk schedules and broader daily research refresh.
Define per-market completion/watermark and last-success/next-due states; retries cannot create duplicate forecasts or hide missed jobs.
Budget batching, source quota, catch-up and throttled loops before enabling schedules.

acceptance: Define next trading day,5/20 trading days and3/6/12months: target, total/price/excess return, currency, calendar target date, maturity and correction policy. A missing bar is recorded as missing, never filled."

stories.title: Transparent rule and statistical baseline
acceptance: Specify the retained indicators/pillars, seeds/lookbacks and macro-basket completeness from forecasting-scope; NAV series do not receive fake candle features.
Implement only after approval: known-answer rules plus naïve/trend and reproducible bootstrap/linear baselines with explicit uncertainty meaning.

acceptance: Use temporal walk-forward folds with horizon-aware purge/embargo and train-only transforms/calibration; deliberately leaky fixtures must fail.
Record dataset hashes, code/feature/model versions, split dates, fees/spreads/income/FX, survivorship and history limits.
Report calibration/error/coverage/turnover/growth/drawdown/sample intervals and benchmarks; decide objective trade-offs and evidence thresholds before promotion.

stories.title: Risk regimes, analogs and event studies
acceptance: Preserve F3 regimes/volatility/downside and F4 analog/event modules with past-only smoothing, horizon-aware neighbour exclusion and uncertainty.
Numerical code computes event count/spread/interval; overlapping outcomes and multiple testing are accounted for.

Sparse/biased event data and missing point-in-time events yield low-evidence/unavailable states rather than a confident effect. A kind that no checked source covers shows as no source yet, and informs no forecast until one qualifies."
evidence: F3/F4 schemas; analog overlap/leakage tests; market/event subgroup evidence

acceptance: Preserve F5 tree/gradient challenger, direction/quantiles/calibration and interpretable drivers; conformal labels require demonstrated time-series coverage.

stories.title: Immutable forecast/outcome scorecards
acceptance: Append forecasts, revisions, mature outcomes and corrections; never overwrite unsuccessful predictions or score before maturity.

acceptance: Require baseline/mature-outcome evidence then shadow observation and explicit owner approval for every live model/calibration/strategy change.

stories.title: Contextual chat and research cards

Test prompt injection, identity/privacy/cross-env leakage, ungrounded numbers, citation failures, no-trading and budget exhaustion; LLM judges do not replace realised outcomes.
Keep eval provenance/cost and human disagreement; approve release thresholds before activation.

stories.title: Owner settings, approvals and scope controls
acceptance: Version schemas/ranges for risk/ranking/agent settings; show proposed impact,evidence,cost and rollback before sensitive approval.

A configuration change cannot grant broader tools, sources, budgets or infrastructure authority.

stories.title: Scoped memory and cache economics
acceptance: Keep owner-visible scoped notes, correction/forget controls, taint and source audit; notes cannot replace ledger values or approved settings.
Bound context and cache stable prefixes only within privacy scopes; measure savings and all cache costs.
Deletion/correction policy covers note derivatives without deleting required durable financial audit evidence.

Search/filter/saved watchlists include unowned candidates, peers/benchmarks/themes and impact on current overlap.
Use approved local design/package baseline; static Sites concept does not count as the PWA.

No-model/in-practice/disabled/stale/unavailable states work in chart and text alternatives; simple/technical modes preserve material uncertainty.

stories.title: Whole-release security, scientific and cost gates
acceptance: Run relevant API/schema/ledger/scientific/no-leakage/agent/accessibility/native/offline/privacy/security gates before any separately approved independent review.
Demonstrate full launch usage and budget fallbacks within £100 aggregate,including dev/prod/evals/collectors/SSE/backups/builds and unverified/no credit cases.

Review blockers,non-blocking issues and rollback readiness; live model gate remains separate from application release approval. MP203-08, 24 November 2026 (MP-203): the owner picked "An environment replaces route A" (pressed on the page). The option read: "A merge to main starts the release, which waits in the production environment for your approval." It replaces route A, chosen 3 November 2026.
evidence: Risk-based gate report; per-market/horizon coverage; aggregate cost and credit failure evidence

stories.title: Owner operations and admin requirements
acceptance: Capture admin requirements now: uploads/versions,ledger updates,runs/tools/models/evals,health,cost and approvals; owner designs the full portal later.
Ship required audit/owner controls in approved launch UX; later portal styling does not defer main-dashboard cost visibility or critical recovery controls.
Retain pause switches,incident escalation,monthly evidence review and documented owner procedures.
evidence: Admin requirements/permission inventory; launch-versus-later UX decision; operations walkthrough

stories.title: Validated market and instrument extensions
acceptance: Use versioned MarketProfile/InstrumentKind/DataSource contracts for mainland China,Taiwan,Hong Kong and continental Europe as later scope.
Check venue/calendar/currency/dual-listing mappings,rights,history,delay and budget; unsupported handlers need tested code and approved deployment.
Each market/kind receives contract,replay,shadow and owner activation evidence; avoid projecting US-only validation across markets.
evidence: Extension admission checklist; hypothetical region/kind cases; incremental cost/rights evidence before activation

stories.title: Themes, segments and bounded broad-universe research
acceptance: Version dated many-to-many theme membership and sources; distinguish marketing labels from measured economic exposures.
Use batched daily quantitative screening and a bounded LLM shortlist; compare themes/peers/benchmarks and holdings overlap.
Historical theme studies use historical constituents; expanded universe/data/model load must fit approved aggregate cost.
evidence: Theme/screen contracts; look-ahead/overlap cases; bounded workload plan

stories.title: New features, model families and horizons
acceptance: Version FeatureSet/ModelAdapter/ForecastTask/Strategy/AgentManifest/EvaluationPack schemas and supported capability matrix.
New computation requires tested trusted code,resource costing,ablation/mature outcomes/shadow evidence and owner promotion.
No arbitrary runtime code/plugin download or self-authorized model/tool/budget expansion.
evidence: Plugin compatibility suite plan; admission/rejection examples; owner rollout protocol

stories.title: Optional MA interchange and eventual retirement boundary
acceptance: No shared live database or required MA API; any optional export/import needs an approved versioned file contract and reconciliation.
Before any later MA advanced-Forecaster retirement,refresh source/code/runtime inventory,prove agreed parity/history preservation,recovery and explicit cutover scope.
MA rules,tracking and XIRR remain; no MA page/issue/source/runtime change is authorized by this plan or its MP story mapping.
evidence: Boundary ADR; conditional parity/cutover checklist; explicit not-authorized record

stories.title: Owner-scoped accounts and listing identities
acceptance: Stable security/share-class and listing identities distinguish venue, trading currency and quote units; aliases are effective-dated.
ISIN/name-only ambiguity produces candidate matches for owner confirmation, never a guessed listing.
Owner/environment scope is enforced at every read/write and account mapping; fixture IDs remain real and private actual holdings stay deferred.
Account/wrapper labels retain source context without implementing unverified tax rules.

stories.title: Private validated upload intake
acceptance: Byte limits, magic type, checksum, archive/page/pixel/runtime checks and quarantine status precede extraction; exact limit values need approval. Answered: MP40-Q1, 5 November 2026 (MP-184): the owner picked "Set from your real statements" (by the owner's words in chat, "for the remaining pick up recommended options"). The option read: "Oversized files stay held as drawn, and the four limits are set from your largest real statements, with a margin, when they arrive." The limit values stay unapproved until then.
Original bytes/version and an upload record exist before processing; an object-created notification cannot mark a ledger import committed.
Repeated/out-of-order upload notifications and orphaned objects reconcile idempotently; rejected uploads have a visible reason.
Protected originals remain private; upload authorization is scoped/short-lived and app-side single-use semantics are enforced rather than assumed from a signed URL.

stories.title: Versioned extraction for every agreed method
acceptance: Deterministic parsers handle supported layouts; document/image LLM extraction is bounded, tool-free and produces validated typed proposals with source locations.
Every field records raw/normalized values, parser/model/schema version and page/sheet/row/cell evidence; missing data remains missing.
Cells/macros/formulas/links and document instructions are untrusted; no script/formula/network execution is needed to import a workbook.

Generic fixtures are distinguished from validated broker layouts; encrypted PDFs are unlocked only through the approved secure local flow, never a logged/model password. Answered: MP40-Q2, 5 November 2026 (MP-184): the owner picked "Local unlock step" (pressed on the page). The option read: "You type the password in a step on your device, which opens the PDF there and uploads the unlocked copy." MP203-07, 24 November 2026 (MP-203): the owner picked "Widen three existing stories" (pressed on the page). The option read: "MP-47 gains the unlock step, MP-107 the factsheet reader and MP-163 the two builds." MP-47 carries the unlock step.

stories.title: Instrument and account matching
acceptance: Matching uses verified identifiers plus venue/currency/share-class context and preserves confidence/evidence.
Unknown/ambiguous matches block only dependent rows until explicit mapping; choosing a mapping creates a new draft revision.
A factsheet alone can describe a candidate instrument but cannot invent owner units, cost or purchase history.
A mapping/template reused later is versioned and scoped; it cannot silently turn one listing into another because a ticker or name looks similar.

stories.title: Exact normalization of money, dates and events
acceptance: Finite decimal strings and explicit units are used; GBX converts to GBP exactly once, and unknown fees/currencies are not silently zero/defaulted.
Source booked net amounts, unit prices, fees/withholding and FX execution/reference rates remain distinguishable and reconcile under an approved tolerance.
Trade/effective, settlement, observed/available and recorded times have explicit meanings; date-only input is not invented into a precise UTC instant.
Each supported event has validated cash/quantity legs; transfers/FX/splits preserve economic boundaries and never sum unlike units.

stories.title: Preview, guided edits and explicit subset selection
acceptance: Preview shows every accepted/blocked/duplicate/excluded row, account and instrument mapping, before/after values, errors and metric eligibility.
An edit/subset/mapping/parser change creates a new canonical draft hash and invalidates earlier approval.
The default partial-file policy remains an owner choice; any approved subset is independently consistent, explicit and traceable.
Confirm/Edit/Cancel/resume/stale/expired states have accessible web/native acceptance scenarios; document content cannot self-approve.

stories.title: Business deduplication and replay-safe identity
acceptance: File identity, source row identity and economic-event identity are separate, scoped and versioned.
Stable provider/account transaction references suppress true replays; two genuine same-date/same-amount trades with distinct IDs remain two events.
Without sufficient reference evidence, a near/exact-content collision is reviewed rather than automatically discarded or inserted.
Reprocessing with a new parser does not bypass economic dedup; a changed fact becomes a correction proposal, not a second original trade.

stories.title: Owner approval and atomic visible commit
acceptance: Approval binds owner/environment, canonical selected rows, draft hash and expected ledger revision with server-verified authentication and expiry.
Concurrent/stale/expired/wrong-scope requests refuse mutation; an ambiguous timeout resolves through the existing durable receipt.
A successful logical commit couples financial changes, required audit and outbox obligations; staged work is invisible to all consumers until a valid activation marker.
Large workbooks use a proven bounded/fenced staging design or another approved atomic-visibility strategy; transaction item/byte limits include metadata/audit and cannot be treated as row counts.

stories.title: Deterministic ledger replay and versioned projections
acceptance: Rebuilding from the same committed events/policy versions produces identical projections; caches are not financial truth.
Trade/settlement and transfer ordering is explicit; unresolved ties or unsupported margin/short behaviour are surfaced rather than guessed.
Failed/staged/superseded work cannot leak into active holdings, metrics, agent context or read APIs.
A later complete history reconciles with an opening observation and activates a new baseline/window, never adds the same units twice.

stories.title: Cash, units and valuation reconciliation
acceptance: Cash/quantity/fees/FX/unit/date/coverage differences are classified with source and derived values and an approved tolerance.
An unexplained difference cannot be cleared by an invented plug trade or silent overwrite.
Price and FX timestamps/availability/quality accompany totals; an unpriced holding leaves a partial total and visible missing coverage.
Owner resolution records the reason and source and creates a new revision when financial facts change.

stories.title: Corrections, reversal and baseline rebase
acceptance: Corrections and import-level reversal are separate preview/approval operations linked to original events and sources.
Dependent later events and observations are assessed before reversal; a bulk delete cannot leave impossible quantities or remove audit history.
Recomputed views are versioned/restated while issued forecasts and their input revisions remain historically identifiable.
A repeated correction/reversal request returns the same result and does not reapply its effects.

stories.title: Incomplete holdings and eligible performance measures
acceptance: Missing purchase history/fees/FX is represented as per-measure insufficiency, not fabricated transactions or a zero return.
Holding/account/portfolio XIRR uses its own defined flow boundary, dated signs, terminal valuation and FX convention; internal portfolio trades/dividends/transfers are not external contributions.
Solver failure, ambiguous multiple roots, same-day-only histories or incomplete terminal valuation return an explicit unavailable/ambiguous result with evidence.
Known-answer and invariant examples verify monetary residuals and rate tolerances with correct units; synthetic outcomes never prove predictive skill.

stories.title: Originals, audit, retention and recovery lineage
acceptance: Every authoritative change carries durable source/actor/approval/commit links; required business lineage is unsampled and separate from short-lived operational telemetry.
Original retention is renewable24months with owner extension/deletion, without assuming automatic expiry or irreversible Object Lock.
A source-deletion request and backup restore cannot resurrect content; remaining evidence joins expose deleted/unavailable source state honestly.
Synthetic missing/altered-audit-event exercises are detected using the approved threat model/anchoring design; a hash chain alone is not described as tamper-proof.

stories.title: Scoped portfolio reads, progress and accessible clients
acceptance: Paginated reads serve owner/account/instrument/date/status access patterns with version/cursor and quality metadata; no unbounded table scan is the default.
SSE reconnect/resume and durable GET recovery cannot lose commit truth or repeat a mutation; starter volatile SSE is not claimed production-ready.
Private values appear only in authorized app views; privacy mode, VoiceOver, responsive/iPad layout and offline/stale states are specified before implementation.
Read-only agents cite the same committed version/evidence; a notification or model summary cannot become an alternative ledger.

stories.title: Owner/environment isolation and bounded processing costs
acceptance: API/worker/source-access/commit paths recheck owner/environment and prevent fixture loading into live data; no trading or broker execution credentials exist.
Signed source links, raw fields/prompts/passwords/account numbers and holdings values do not enter general telemetry or push previews.
Extraction/retry/queue work has bounded file/time/token/concurrency reservations and idempotent usage accounting; unknown credit pauses uncovered model calls.
Import activity links to the main per-env Claude/AWS cost dashboard; collectors remain cached/scheduled, with no paid billing call per UI refresh.

stories.title: Layer acceptance and later real-sample qualification
acceptance: All declared L1 examples pass across local/dev with real identifiers and simulated observations; source originals/golden records remain intact.
Fault injection covers duplicate delivery, stale approvals, crash-midstage, ambiguous commit response, source tampering, cross-scope access and deletion-after-restore.
Generic PDF/PNG/CSV foundations are accurately labelled; missing Excel/real-broker/photographed-image cases remain visible until filled and tested.

Implementation readiness requires approved unresolved choices, source/data rights before live use, tested supported layouts, complete UX and trace from requirements to evidence; phase status or a diagram alone cannot certify completion.

readiness_limit: Detailed import drafts and 48 umbrellas are not certified ready; decompose/allocate target Jira stories before UX. Existing PH identifiers preserved.
